held_item_info.setting.shown.tooltip: Whether the lines about the item in your hand show above the hotbar.
held_item_info.setting.durability.toolti: How much durability a tool, weapon or piece of armour has left, out of its most. Yellow under a quarter, red under a tenth.
held_item_info.setting.count.tooltip: How many items the stack in your hand holds, and how many of the same your whole inventory holds when that is more.
held_item_info.setting.enchantments.tool: Up to six of the item's enchantments with their levels, an enchanted book's too, cut to fit the screen.
